title: palicourea costularia
intro: Palicourea costularia, commonly known as the Brazilian madhouse tree, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Brazil, for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and microbial infections. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea costularia include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a valuable resource for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea costularia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
